efi-upper-intake.summary: The plenum receives air from the twin throttle openings and distributes it through six curved runners to the lower manifold.
efi-upper-intake.limits: The compact plenum and two-ended runner spread follow comparison images. Dimensions, casting ribs, bosses and internal wall distribution remain inferred; this is not a manufacturing model.

steps.title: Trace the six paths
steps.text: See through covers reveals separate runner passages that join the common plenum. The lower flange keeps its existing six connections.

steps.title: Find the throttle joint
steps.text: The throttle mounts directly to the twin-port face. Its lever, cable bracket and sensors move with the assembly when the intake location changes.

oil-filler-cap.summary: The screw cap closes the oil-fill opening above the rocker compartment. Turning the cap advances it along the matching neck thread.
oil-filler-cap.limits: Thread pitch, neck construction and seal section are educational estimates. CAD removal clearance does not establish production dimensions, torque or leak tightness.

steps.title: Locate the neck
steps.text: The continuous neck joins the cover around one fill opening. The former provisional opening has been closed.

steps.title: Find the sealing land
steps.text: A separate annular seal lies between cap and neck. The model shows nominal contact without elastic compression.

oil-filler-cap-seal.summary: This illustrative annular seal closes the joint between the cap and oil-fill neck when the cap is seated.
oil-filler-cap-seal.limits: Its material, section and compression have not been verified for the installed cap. Nominal surface contact is not a leak test.

egr-exhaust-tube.summary: The tube connects the fixed exhaust-manifold fitting to the EGR valve inlet, carrying exhaust toward the intake when the valve opens.
egr-exhaust-tube.limits: Its route is inferred around the revised intake. The 18.796 mm outside diameter comes from a replacement-part listing; wall thickness, bends and the catalog length datum remain unverified.

steps.title: Follow the hot-gas route
steps.text: The tube remains connected at both ends; its sleeve surrounds the middle span. The revised route keeps the manifold end fixed.

egr-control-vacuum-hose.summary: The hose connects the fixed vacuum regulator to the EGR diaphragm connection.
egr-control-vacuum-hose.limits: The revised hose follows the moved EGR valve. Its estimated tip has nominal contact with the nipple; grip, elastic compression and sealing are not simulated.
